rules.statement: A Kandyan deed of gift executed prior to January 1, 1939, is revocable unless specifically made irrevocable by the donor.
rules.supporting_quote: "All deeds or gifts, says Sawers, 'excepting those made to priests and temples whether conditional or unconditional, are revocable in Kandyan Law and that before a particular deed is held to be exceptional to this rule it should be shown that 'the circumstances which constitute non revocability appear most clearly on the face of the deed itself.'"
